notes: Card: no single token ('-based', 'DN', ' principle', ' myths', Arabic 'مذهب' = doctrine, 'Adversus Haereses'). Probes: 'accounting principle' 0.92, 'evidence-based practices' 0.93, 'nutrition myths' 0.96, 'accounting standards' 0.51, 'safety myths' 0.46, 'data-driven advice' 0.66; but 'design principles' 0.05, 'plant-based' 0.06, 'rule-based / faith-based' 0.13, 'doctrine ... dogma' 0.23. So it is not the words alone; the label is a guess at the shared context and may be a list.
